title: Source Engine
summary: Adds HDR support to Source Engine games (integer HDR path) by upgrading the scene render targets and replacing engine_post with a tone mapper while keeping the software AA, bloom, and color-correction LUTs.
notes: Run the game in its normal Direct3D 9 mode (no -vulkan). Load ReShade as d3d9.dll with DXVK underneath, like the other DX9 mods, so the D3D11/D3D12 swapchain proxy can present HDR and ps_3_0 replacements can pair with the game's vs_2_0 shaders.
Requires the game's HDR rendering (mat_hdr_level 2) so the scene is exposed by cLightScale before the RGBA16F targets.
Use borderless/windowed mode for HDR output.
